notes.title: Patch 20231001
notes.notes:
Path notes
[list]
[*] Fixed map-3 (Varuda) that was shifted too far to the left by accident
[*] Fixed various spelling errors
[*] Howls now show their proper unique names
[*] Adjusted game balance in minor ways, making it slightly more difficult at higher levels
[*] Tutorials added for Relationships (paradise map), Attributes (character status screen) and Skills (Skills screen)
[*] Equipment screen will now always show the statistics of the current equipment, based on the active tab (weapon, ring and amulet)
[*] Fixed weapon abilities like poison. Such abilities have a chance to trigger when using normal attacks
[*] Fixed a bug regarding Rhea final VN Scene not starting (rank 9 scene)
[*] Fixed a bug where some boat docks wouldnt trigger the go-home event
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 20230919
notes.notes:
This hotfix deals with a bug when starting a new game

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that gave Alex invalid data when starting a new game. This bug was introduced by the previous patch. Loading a save with the faulty data should load normally now and nothing should be lost. 
[/list]

notes.title: Small patch 20240914
notes.notes:
Another bug got in due to multiple genders
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that saved Alex's data wrongly and loading it would reset Alex data to level 1.  The data is not gone, just wrongly placed. The patch has a fix that will load previous saves and places the correct data, even if it was saved in the wrong spot before.
[*] Fixed functionality of the counter ability that some items offer. Counters will take the place of a single reaction per turn by counter-attacking an attack. 
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch 20230909
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some Visual Novel events from progressing properly due to the introduction of alternative outfits that came with the full release of the game. This involved an event of Neelu, Rhea and Roy.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 20230906 - Patching the Patch
notes.notes:
The previous patch sadly introduced a game-breaking bug. This patch will fix that fault in addition to a few smaller ones.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was introduced by the previous patch in relation to savefiles, which would record faulty data for the difficulty setting (including values that go out of bounds). Any saves from before the previous patch should have been working normally, but saves afterwards could break the game when engaging in battle.
 
Savefile data itself is not corrupt or lost however and after this patch, any faulty savefile are automatically restored without any loss of game progression.
Any savefile that is loaded now will check if the difficulty value is faulty and if so, set it to normal
Any new saves after his patch will store the correct difficulty value.  

[*] Fixed a "potential" bug where male alex was using the female battler
[*] Fixed a rare bug that could happen when switching partymembers using a formation skill, due to accepting multiple inputs. The bug would cause multiple battlers to spawn of the friend being switched-in. Hilarious perhaps, but it should not have happened.
[*] Fixed some minor clipping issues in Roy's battler animations
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2023-09-02
notes.notes:
Patch 20230902
[list]
[*] Fixed female alex animations in battle
[*] Fixed some odd special fx placement on certain enemies
[*] Fixed a bug when in battle, the skill was checked against older data, making the skill unable to activate in battle
[*] Fixed displaying wrong save info when saving/loading. This was purely a cosmetic bug that could happen when renaming savefile names or overwriting them with saves from a different saveslot position
[/list]
  
Thank you all for reporting any bugs you all found, we will do our best to fix them all as soon as possible.

notes.title: Tropical Hearts Releases Today!
notes.notes:
Dear fans!

We’ve got great news! At long last, Tropical Hearts is fully released! 

Thank you so much for your patience and support. We had a blast working on our very first game and we truly hope you’ll enjoy every moment of it.

As always, don’t hesitate to join our Discord to receive tech support, get the latest news and meet other players!

Cheers!
SilkyFangs & Rubicus - Kokolori Studios


Patch Notes:

- All 66 Dates are now fully playable as both Male and Female Alex

- Some new unique skills for your party members, play and explore your new abilities!

- The third, completely new island with new bosses and new materials to gather! Experience the final conclusion to our heroes’ extended vacation!

- The full game now extends to 28 days for explorations and romance

- New Evening wear and swimwear sprites for almost all characters

- All background art is fully finished (except for one. SilkyFangs is so sorry and will update it soon)

- Renamed Skip button to Fast, as its function can confuse players who played other Visual Novels. The button simply makes text go very fast.

- Longer animations + confirmation button for Harvesting / Meditation / Mining 

- Alex’s portrait is now dimmer when they aren’t talking

- Expanded available save slots to 30

notes.title: Chapter 3 is on the Way!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

It's SilkyFangs with a quick update from Kokolori Studios. For the past months, Rubicus and I have been working on creating new content and battle updates for the third and final Chapter of the game.

Most of the work for the third Island is done. Rubicus is currently working on the Boss battles and I'm writing the story events that will reveal the island's secrets. Rubicus has been adding more varied cheers to the battles.

Of course, I'm also busy writing new story events and creating more art or refining previous sprites and backgrounds. 

As promised for the full release, players will now be able to choose Alex' gender. I've been updating  past story events to implement the proper pronouns and I'm currently updating all of Alex's visuals. 

We're aiming for a full release in early August and can't wait to finally share the complete Tropical Hearts experience with you all! Thank you for your ongoing patience and support!

Cheers,

SilkyFangs & Rubicus

notes.title: Ember Island is now Live!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce the release of Ember Island! This major update features an entire new expedition island for you to discover, plenty of new enemies and bosses to slay, and it contains more than 30 brand new story events!

As Alex and his friends explore Ember Island, there will be plenty of new Skills for them to master. And all is not what it seems...something strange is afoot, and our heroes need to find out what mysteries the ruins on Ember Island are hiding.

STORY UPDATES:

[list][*]Get to know your friends and the inhabitants of Paradise Island more in-depth! There’s 20 new Dating events, most of which have doubled in duration compared to the first chapter. Every Date now features several moments of interaction.
[/list]

[list][*]Reach up to Rank 6 with the main cast and up to Rank 4 with the side characters. There's more than 7 days of dating awaiting you!
[/list]

[b]BATTLE UPDATES:

[list][*] Easy, Normal and Hard Mode are now available. The game, due to balance testing, was set to Hard. You can now adjust the difficulty at any time outside of battles.
[/list]

[list][*] Loaded games from before this update will automatically switch to Normal. If you’d like to keep the challenge, you can change it back to Hard in the settings menu.
[/list]

[list][*]From now on, your party’s HP will recover after battle. In Easy Mode, SP will mostly recover as well. On normal, SP has a small recovery, while on Hard, SP does not auto-recover. Additional SP can still be recovered by eating at a campsite or using Spirit Fruit-type consumables, either during or outside of battles.
[/list]

[list][*]You can now collect vital information on your enemies by defeating them, learning more about their strengths and weaknesses in the process. Click the Beast Book Icon in the game menu to find out more.
[/list]

[list][*]During expeditions, it’s now possible to travel to Paradise Island from certain coastal locations. When you return to Ember Island, you’ll start in the same spot where you left.
[/list]

[list][*]You can warp to any campsite you have discovered before, allowing quicker travel across expedition maps. Active camps will glow, unexplored camps will not.
[/list]

[list][*]Dolores’ Town Shop will sell new crafting materials every new week in case players are missing resources from previous islands.
[/list]

[list][*]Combat and reward balance have been refined, and there’s a minor increase in healing as well as increase in damage toward higher levels.
[/list]

[list][*]Guarding is now implemented as well and shows a special FX.
[/list]

[list][*]Mining and herb gathering on Paradise Island now include more varied and useful drops.
[/list]

[list][*]Cocktail mixing has been made more user-friendly.
[/list]

[list][*]Players only have 6 days to clear an island. Not clearing the island in time will result in a game-over.
[/list]

[list][*]Music will be streamed from your drive, lowering the RAM usage of the game by more than 50%.
[/list][/b]

We hope you’ll enjoy Ember Island! This update contains the second out of three chapters of Tropical Hearts. Once we’ve finished the third and final chapter, the game will leave Early Access and be officially released.

Feel free to join our Discord for feedback, bug reports and meeting other fans of Tropical Hearts! Find us at https://discord.com/invite/jqSqN5DHhf

Cheers,

KokoLori Studios

notes.title: Patch notes for December 7
notes.notes:
We just released our very first Patch. We want to thank everyone who played Tropical Hearts and provided us with valuable feedback!

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed broken battles in nodes on the expedition map (north and east side)
[*] fixed negative exp gains. Now a minimum of 10% of experience is the limit. When loading a save file it will set any negative exp values to 0, for people who gained an experience debt due to this bug.
[*] Swamplord scale and position adjusted (1/4th of previous size)
[*] Characters now fully recover after returning to Paradise Island from expeditions
[*] Confusion (and likewise charm/enraged status where the AI takes control of the player character’s turn) fixed for player characters
[*] Special FX above the head for status effects like confusion and charm should be shown properly now.
[*] Multiple input on activities would spawn multiple activity results. Now it wont accept multiple clicks anymore.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an option to add save prompts between long scenes. Currently added one between prologue and aftermath VN scenes
[*] Added the space-key and left mouse-button clicks inside the text box as alternative means to continue visual novel scenes, besides the default enter-key
[*] Added an info block for current equipment of the relative equipment slot, when selecting an item to equip, to help to compare them before confirming the equipping of said item
[*] Added a back button to the load and save screens where needed, as an alternative to pressing escape.
[*] Hidden the party/character/skill/equipment buttons in the main menu bar before day 3, to avoid possible spoilers concerning the character’s abilities. 
[/list]
